arguments.command:
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG=nothingness_linux_debug; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG=/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO=/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME=/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, base64, subprocess
cmd = [
  '.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py','call','ext.nothingness.dragByKeyScreenshotMid',
  'key=hero-seek-gesture-surface','dx=300','dy=0','steps=24','midStep=12','pixelRatio=1.0'
]
res = subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True)
data=json.loads(res)
img=base64.b64decode(data['during']['png_base64'])
out='.tmp/agent_shots/seek_during.png'
with open(out,'wb') as f: f.write(img)
print('wrote',out,len(img))
PY
